title: Chapter 1461 Chapter 8: Unity (Part 2)

Chapter 1461 Chapter 8: Unity (Part 2)

Chapter 1461 Chapter 8: Unity (Part 2)

They are completely different matters.

The latter means that even if I account for all my trump cards and hidden moves, I still can't match the strength that the Galaxy Lord displays openly.

"The power that the Galaxy Lord wields... is simply monstrous."

At this moment, the Fantian Lord, sitting beside, spoke, a tone of amazement in his voice.

The higher the realm, the stronger one becomes, the more one can sense the terrifying power Lin Yuan holds, intertwining the four "Tai' powers: Taiyi, Taichu, Taishi, and Taisu, able to sweep through all in the infinite dimensional realms.

Lord Wan Xiang listened quietly.

Though the Fantian Lord didn't say it explicitly,

the implication was also that he considered himself no match for that Galaxy Lord.

"A new path of transcendence has appeared, indeed giving birth to many unimaginable variables."

The fourth Legendary Lord spoke, in the past, for Lords of their legendary level, which among them was not illustrious, intimidating the many time-spaces of past, present, and future?

Let alone birthing one of the same level, even someone just nearing their strength, they would definitely know; unlike now, the Galaxy Lord had already surpassed them, yet this was the first time hearing of him.

"Indeed, it's a variable."

Lord Wan Xiang nodded, then looked at the other Legendary Lords, his tone slightly solemn: "With the strength of the Galaxy Lord, if any

of us meet him alone, none can withstand it."

Once these words were out.

All the Legendary Lords present fell silent.

It was true.

Perhaps they wouldn't be crushed like Lord Zhuo He, unable to endure even a single breath.

But defeat and doom were inevitable.

"We have known each other for many years." Lord Wan Xiang continued: "If in the future on this new path of transcendence, we find ourselves opposing the Galaxy Lord, I hope we can join forces, to eliminate the Galaxy Lord first as much as possible."

"Join forces?"

Lord Haotian and the Fantian Lord pondered thoughtfully.

If it were other times, with their pride, they would definitely disdain

to join forces to bully one with many.

But this is on the path to transcendence, involving the hope of transcendence, transcending is the ultimate goal, it's only natural for the weaker side to join forces to oppose the stronger party.

If not, being individually picked off by the Galaxy Lord would basically forfeit their chance to transcend.

Only by joining forces and first dealing with the Galaxy Lord could they hope to transcend.

As for the struggle among themselves after dealing with the Galaxy Lord?

At least there existed a chance of victory, unlike facing the Galaxy Lord, where there was no hope.

"No problem."

"No problem."

Lord Haotian and the Fantian Lord nodded successively.

On another alabaster staircase.

The Sage's eyes burned with passion: "I have experienced countless ages, born soon after the opening of the infinite dimensional realms, although the tribulations I have undergone are not as many as Haotian, Fantian, but in terms of accumulated foundation, I am undoubtedly the strongest."

The Sage's heart was full of excitement, before the alabaster staircase appeared, no matter how much foundation was accumulated, it wasn't of much use, because there was no evolution direction for the self's Chaotic Origin Dao, the use of accumulated foundation simply couldn't be brought out.

But now?

With the continuous climb of the alabaster staircase, the Sage's accumulation was rapidly stimulated, feeling his strength surging

swiftly.

"This new path of transcendence is so befitting for me, perhaps my chance for transcendence lies here?"

The Sage composed himself and continued the ascent.

"Hoo!"

Climbing the alabaster staircase, Lin Yuan continuously attempted to use the Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao to nurture the 'Tai' power.

Strands of strange power continuously emerged, intertwining and merging with the other four "Tai' powers.

As more and more "Tai' power was nurtured, the quantitative change triggered a qualitative change, finally forming a complete "Tai' power, on par with the Taiyi, Taichu, Taishi, and Taisu four "Tai" powers.

"Innate Five Great..."

Lin Yuan let out a gentle breath, a smile appearing on his face.

The complete weaving of the five "Tai' powers began to greatly nourish Lin Yuan's physical body and soul; at this moment, numerous true bodies and incarnations of the Primordial Spirit were growing explosively at a terrifying speed.

Compared to the four types of "Tai' powers in operation before, the gathering of the five types of 'Tai' powers is a qualitative change, a completion, and to some extent, a form of perfection.

"My current strength is far more powerful than before."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly; at this moment, his strength definitely surpasses the Legendary Lord of three hundred million tribulations. Perhaps reaching three hundred twenty million times? Three hundred twenty million nine hundred times?

The infinite tribulations' path of transcendence has a third stage, which includes three hundred thirty million tribulations. The last three thousand tribulations are the most challenging, and once surpassed, the strength increase is even greater.

Now, Lin Yuan feels that his strength may be close to the level of thirty-three thousand tribulations, which is the endpoint of the infinite tribulations' path of transcendence.

"But I feel that I am still far from transforming and transcending the Supreme Rule Dao. Is the endpoint of the infinite tribulations' path of transcendence not true transcendence?"

Thoughts surfaced in Lin Yuan's mind but were quickly suppressed as he began to devote himself to climbing the white jade steps. Whether or not infinite tribulations lead to transcendence is not important; his most crucial task now is to ascend the white jade steps. "The Innate Five Great divides as-Taiyi, Tai Chu, Taishi, Taisu, Taiji." "Among them, Taiji is nurtured by one's own Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao.

Therefore, the other four types of "Tai' powers should also need to evolve into corresponding Chaotic Origin Dao."

Lin Yuan climbed the white jade steps step by step, and the direction towards the Supreme Rule Dao gradually became clear, allowing him to quickly understand his subsequent tasks.

Using the foundation of Taiyi Power, Tai Chu Power, Taishi Power, and Taisu Power to evolve the Chaotic Origin Taiyi Dao, Chaotic Origin Tai Chu Dao, Chaotic Origin Taishi Dao, and Chaotic Origin Taisu Dao.

Within a certain space-time.

Lin Yuan was chatting with the Purple Light Legendary Lord and

other Legendary Lords.

His climbing of the white jade steps occupies the majority of Lin

Yuan's energy and mind, but every once in a while, he still probes external information.

It's considered a relaxation aside from climbing the white jade steps.

"Galaxy, that Lord Zhuo He couldn't even last half a breath against

you, how strong is your current power?" The Purple Light Legendary Lord exclaimed.

Even if his insight wasn't as sharp as Dark Star Lord, the Purple Light Legendary Lord still vaguely realized that at this moment, even Lord Haotian and the others were probably not Lin Yuan's match.

Lin Yuan listened with a smile. Sometimes casually replying with a sentence.

"By the way, Galaxy, you should still be careful; Lord Haotian and Lord

Fantian are definitely paying attention to you, and there might be a possible alliance afterward." The Purple Light Legendary Lord said.

Regarding Lin Yuan, he could only feel respected, as their strength gap was too vast, leaving no competitive relationship. Hence, the reminder to Lin Yuan was genuine. The three hundred million tribulations' Legendary Lords, Lord Haotian, Lord Fantian, and others, have known each other for a long time. If it truly came to the point of contention with Lin Yuan, chances are high they would join forces to deal with Lin Yuan first.

After all, Lin Yuan's strength and means were unknown, posing the

greatest threat. "Understood."

Lin Yuan nodded.

If it were before nurturing the 'Tai' Power, he might have been wary of the Legendary Lords, Lord Haotian, Lord Fantian, and others. Solely relying on the Innate Four Great powers might allow him to suppress a Legendary Lord of three hundred million tribulations, but against their alliance? Lin Yuan wouldn't be so confident.

But now?

With the nurturing of the Innate Fifth Tai-Tai' Power, Lin Yuan's

strength underwent a qualitative change, feeling capable of challenging a Legendary Lord above three hundred twenty million tribulations.

In a sense, after completing the "Innate Five Great," Lin Yuan no

longer took the current space-time's Legendary Lords seriously.

On the endless white jade stairs.

Lin Yuan's figure was solitary, continuously climbing.

"Oh?"

At this moment, Lin Yuan stopped his steps, looked up towards the

highest point the white jade steps led to.

He had climbed to an extremely high position, looking around,

space-time was blurry, and no other climbers could be seen.

At this height, Lin Yuan took a close look and vaguely saw thirty-three thousand three hundred thirty-two other white jade steps.

If one continues to look upwards, they would vaguely discover that as

the altitude increases, all the white jade steps are converging.

Ultimately-

They converge into a single white jade step.

"Thirty-three thousand three hundred thirty-three white jade steps

would eventually merge into one white jade step?"

Lin Yuan observed from afar.
